visualCharacteristics.purpose: wrapping grid of icon-led feature items, each with a heading, text and optional list or button

contentPattern.structure: one row per item: icon or image | heading + text + optional list + optional CTA link. The icon may instead be the first paragraph of the body cell. Text-only rows (process steps) are fine

reuseGuidance: Use for benefit or feature highlights and numbered process steps. Put the section heading and any footnote as default content in the same section. For a single text + photo split use columns-feature.
